about.title: What is UTP Assistant?
about.subtitle: An open-source chatbot for students, applicants and anyone with questions about the University of Telecommunications and Post.
about.whatBody: The assistant answers from a knowledge base of official UTP information – programs, fees, deadlines, contacts and guidelines for coursework and theses. You can ask in Bulgarian or English, at any time and without an account. Answers are generated by a language model, so check the university website before making important decisions.
goals: Fewer repeated questions for the administration
Quick answers for students and applicants, without waiting
University information available at any time, from any device
A practical example of using AI in a university setting
about.openSourceBody: The code is public on GitHub. You can report a bug, suggest an idea or contribute there.
